evidence.reason: In `two_slot_health`, line 1353 reads the heartbeat via `_tick_value(effects)` before invoking the injected `observe` callback on line 1354. On a fresh host with no `heartbeat.json`, that read fails before the first-tick wait can run, so an absent-but-soon-published heartbeat is treated as a health failure instead of being retried within the existing first-tick timeout. This is an implementation error in intended first-tick polling behavior, not a request to enlarge scope.
